audit_date: 2026-10-13 local session date; Claude handoff dated 2026-10-14
scope: 14 actual quantized atlas frames; no raw/source generation used as audit substitute
method: Manual pixel landmarks read on nearest-neighbor crops. Values are projected garment/visible segment estimates. Range endpoints explicitly include landmark ambiguity; no anatomical bone reconstruction. H includes crown hair through chin. S heel-to-toe only for visible profile shoe. No neutral-height normalization. Limb ±6/±7 is not a ±6% pass.
